report_name: Widespread Microsoft 365 Outage Hits Millions of Users Globally

identities.name: Microsoft
identities.description: Provider of the Microsoft 365 services that experienced a global outage due to a large number of servers failing health checks. The incident was tracked by Microsoft under identifiers MO1550821 and EX1550543.

identities.name: Global Microsoft 365 Users
identities.description: Millions of users and organizations across various sectors globally who were impacted by the Microsoft 365 service outage affecting Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Copilot.

indicators.name: Monitoring of Microsoft Service Health Status Page
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Monitoring of Microsoft Service Health Status Page
id: 9b88c7e1-a1b2-4c3d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects network traffic to the Microsoft 365 service health status page. This is not inherently malicious but can be used for proactive monitoring of cloud service provider status.
references:
  - https://ransomnews.com/microsoft-365-outage-cyberattack-november-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
level: informational
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|startswith: 'https://status.office.com/'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Benign administrative traffic.
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to Microsoft's official service health status page, which can be used for proactive monitoring of cloud service provider status.

indicators.name: Anomalous Azure AD Sign-in Failure
indicators.pattern:
title: Azure AD Sign-in Failure
id: 5d4e3c2b-1a09-4f8e-8d7c-6b5a4d3c2b1a
status: experimental
description: Detects a single Azure Active Directory sign-in failure. A surge of these events can be an early indicator of a platform-wide issue like the Microsoft 365 outage of November 2026. This rule is intended for baseline monitoring and requires tuning or correlation to detect a surge.
references:
  - https://ransomnews.com/microsoft-365-outage-cyberattack-november-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
level: informational
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: signinlogs
detection:
  selection:
    UserPrincipalName|exists: true
  filter_success:
    ResultType: '0'
  condition: selection and not filter_success
falsepositives:
  - Any individual user sign-in failure (e.g., wrong password). This rule is intended for aggregation.
indicators.description: Detects Azure Active Directory sign-in failures. The article suggests that a surge in such failures can be an early indicator of a platform-wide issue.
